news.body:
## Your last day at a desk
- The Amazon Launch assessment is dated today, and Amazon will not look at the application until it is done.
You got the application in yesterday, six days early, which is the good news. The assessment itself does not expire until 2 December, so the date is mine rather than theirs - but it wants one uninterrupted sitting and tomorrow you are on a plane.
- Today is the start-by for both Google applications, Dublin and London, and they close on the 8th.
Everything they ask for is the CV and the profile you finished in October, so this is form-filling rather than writing. - Both in today means the 8th passes while you are settling in India rather than chasing a deadline.

## What I told you yesterday was already out of date
- There is no KITAS renewal to wait for. Chitra at InCorp wrote overnight that it is no longer possible.
A renewal had to start about a month before the 8 November expiry, so the revised quote I pointed you at yesterday was never going to arrive. Staying past the 8th would be an overstay at a million rupiah a day, with your sponsor exposed too. - So the cancellation and the exit permit before you fly are the whole of it now, and that is a call rather than an email.
